soldier: Head pale yellow, mandibles blackish brown, pilosity of the head capsule sparse. Head capsule rectangular, head-width index about 0.62, lateral margins slightly arcuate and slightly widened posteriorly, posterior margin broadly rounded. Frontal peaks slightly raised. Labrum sharply lanceolate, apex shortly needle-like, apical setae present, lateral apical setae present or absent. Mandibles stout, apex strongly curved; mandible length about 0.59 times head capsule length and 0.95 times head width. Antennae 16–17 segments. Broad region of the postmentum before the anterior fifth; waist region narrow and elongate, margins nearly parallel, waist constriction index about 0.30. Pronotum kidney-shaped, about 1.75 times as wide as long, anterior margin shallowly concave in the middle, posterior margin distinctly incised in the middle; about 4 setae in the middle region.
